stepExplanation: The ester name comes from: (1) the alkyl group of the alcohol (ethyl- from ethanol) and (2) the acid name with -oic acid changed to -oate (propanoate from propanoic acid). Answer: ethyl propanoate
stepBody: Using IUPAC nomenclature, name the ester formed. Remember: The alcohol contributes the first part (alkyl group) and the acid contributes the second part (-oate ending).
